text: Fixed and verified. The `key` branch previously stored `key(item) -> item` in a dict, so later duplicates overwrote earlier ones (keeping the last item per key). I changed it to track seen keys in a set and append each item only on first encounter — the same logic as the `key=None` path — so the first item seen per key is kept, in first-seen order. `dedupe(["a", "B", "A", "b"], key=str.lower)` now returns `["a", "B"]`, and all existing tests pass.
